china_race_dynamics.text: Mr. Raby, another one of my bills on the agenda today is called the American Voices in Federal Lands Act, because during a previous administration, I was concerned over the public comment process regarding the BLM. We saw last time the number of comments coming in from China and how that was impacting things—well, we got all these comments, but they weren't people that were necessarily looking into the best interest of our home states or of our nation.
